minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  January 23, 2020

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, January 23,
2020, at 2:00 pm in the Community Room “A” 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Cheryl Moor, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Qiana Lowe, Finance Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items
A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
January 9, 2020.

Special Permit Request(s):

Item #1:  Ranzel Cross DBA SCE to host Black History Month at Rogers Park, 400
  W. Beach Ave, Friday February 7, 2020, from 10:30 a.m. to 1:00p.m.;
  Applicant to provide security to maintain and manage crowd control
  throughout the duration of the event; Any person directing traffic is required
  to wear highly-visible retro-reflective vests; street closures are not
  permitted; parking lot is to be; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; ensure safe
  pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; and Adhere to all applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage, local, state and federal laws. Motion carried and second (Activity
  No. 00295852)

Item #2:  Sergio Gonzalez DBA North Gate Markets to host Valentine Day Sale at
  10801 S. Prairie Ave, Friday, February 14, 2020, from 6:00 a.m. to 8:00
  p.m.; approved one day event in parking lot; applicant responsible for
  crowd control and event clean up; must have adequate (at least 2) private
  licensed security guards for potential crowd control; adhere to all applicable
